sourceFile: 8. BRS-161014  GMI Report test VP new mold #11, #12 date 21.9.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies the mold #11/#12 validation context but has incorrect NG-rate calculations and invalid measurement grouping.
issues: Sub 1 NG rate uses wrong control rate and likely wrong total-rate field.
Function outcome calls mold #12 worse despite near-equal rate and source decision allowing #12.
FO measurements are misparsed from mold numbers instead of measured values.
Measurement outcomes are fragmented by rows instead of grouped tables and averages.
Review title is a data row, not the report topic.
correctionPlan: Rebuild changed factor as normal VP baseline versus test VP mold #11 and #12.
Recalculate NG rates from the total NG and total rate columns for each section.
Align judgements with source conclusion: #12 usable, #11 needs improvement.
Regroup SPL, THD, IMP, and FO as measurement tables with proper condition columns and averages.
Replace title/purpose with report title and purpose rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient because parsed values and grouping are wrong.
